question: Can conservative real-performance annotation conversion produce traceable, correctly graded pitch and position tasks for the bounded coach?
decision: Qualify real music contexts for a live coach contract evaluation, without claiming teaching efficacy or transcription accuracy.
unit: One source recording for split membership and one first eligible measure per recording for coaching. Individual note questions are dependent observations within a recording.

split.crossGroup: All remaining combinations excluded from these primary cohorts
split.knownErrata: Three official affected recordings excluded from question generation

controls: Independent exhaustive enumeration of alternate strings and frets
Pitch answers computed with an independent 12-class name table
Synthetic boundary unit fixtures kept separate from the real dataset
actor: Existing deterministic TabToPitch exercise generator and grader; no inference in this stage
judge: Explicit code invariants; no language-model judge

measures.name: eligibility
measures.missingness: Reject malformed source records; no dropped rows without a reason

measures.name: pitchAnswerContract
measures.numerator: Independently computed pitch labels accepted by the application grader

measures.name: alternatePositionContract
measures.numerator: Valid alternative locations accepted by the grader
measures.denominator: All independently enumerated positions for generated location questions
measures.missingness: Any position-set or grading discrepancy stops publication

confounders: Frets derived from pitch and tuning rather than separately observed
Note and contour annotations share the same recorded source and are not independent labels
Experimental stability filters can reject genuine notes and do not prove absence of harmonics
Only one performer and one progression family in the strict test cohort
Pitch/location families only; no coverage claim for other exercise families
collectionRetryPolicy: Pinned read-only acquisition may retry. Preserve all source bytes. Missing or malformed records stop the builder; no replacement test examples after observing model output.
stopGates: Frozen test cohort does not contain all 20 recordings
privacyBoundary: Public licensed music annotations only. No user Guitar Pro attachment, audio, user filenames, learner history, credentials, or synthetic learner outcomes.
publicationIdentities: Per-run provenance.json and the parent live-campaign manifest own cloud dataset and call IDs. This builder makes no cloud writes.

claims.observed: Human-performed guitar has pitch, time and string annotations
claims.inferred: Stable normalized notes can support deterministic pitch questions
claims.confidence: Measured contract validity; source annotation accuracy not independently measured
